Hi James Carter,

I'm Prashant Biswas from Ganit. We are a full-stack Data & AI company, recognized by Everest, Forrester, and Analytics India.

James, leading growth and platform engineering at HubSpot means your team in Boston is under constant pressure to ship the right product bets fast — and in a cost-optimization cycle, slow feedback loops between what 200,000+ customers actually do and what lands on the roadmap become a direct tax on HubSpot's ability to defend and expand its CRM platform lead.

Teams using real-time customer signals and tighter A/B testing infrastructure have cut the lag between behavioral data and roadmap decisions from weeks to days, directly improving feature adoption rates without adding headcount.

We're an AWS Advanced Tier Partner with 6+ years of partnership and 25+ Databricks-certified resources, so we work natively inside the stack your platform teams already run on.

Would a focused 20-minute call this week make sense to walk through how other high-scale SaaS engineering orgs have closed that feedback loop?

With regards,
Ganit team
